scope.matchingRule: A normalized exact name match moves a leading numeric file prefix to a trailing suffix. A core-only match ignores numeric sequence and is only a candidate for human review. Neither result authorizes replay.

nextAction: Review historical candidates and duplicate ledger names using migration deployment commits, branch history, schema evidence and source body hashes. The historical sweep finds candidate source names for 67/130 rows, but none is an automatic replay authorization.
matchingWarnings: Current-branch matching and historical-branch matching are separate views; a file absent from the rebuild branch may exist in an old feature/release branch.
All matches are filename-derived candidates only. Matching a name and sequence does not prove the SQL body that ran in staging or its exact deployed commit.
Different parallel migration branches reuse numeric migration identifiers for different SQL bodies (including the 0087–0096 range). Never merge or replay files based on sequence number alone.

A source body may have a timestamped Supabase filename whose timestamp differs from the actual migration ledger version. It remains a semantic candidate until contents and deployment evidence are reconciled.
